name: figma-maxxing
description: Agent skills for real Figma files: Plugin API gotchas, checks before and after every write, comments to verified fixes, handoff gate.

interface.longDescription: Eight Agent Skills for AI agents that work on real Figma files. figma-canon holds the Plugin API rules and gotchas and loads them piece by piece. figma-preflight checks the connection, the target, the variables, the components and the icons before any write, without touching the canvas. figma-slop-check and figma-handoff-gate review the result after a write and before handoff. figma-comment-fix-loop reads every open comment, fixes each one on the frame where it is pinned and returns the evidence. figma-orient maps a file that is new to the session, figma-click-flow draws flow arrows for static handoff, and figma-bridge-doctor checks and repairs the Figma Desktop connection. Written for the figma-console-mcp Desktop Bridge in Figma Desktop; figma-preflight also accepts the official Figma MCP use_figma tool. The comment workflow needs a Figma personal access token, and the bridge automation is macOS only. The plugin contains skills only: no MCP server and no hooks. Not affiliated with Figma.
